Saw2Recomp 0.1.7 — build stamp
==============================
Config: RelWithDebInfo (win-amd64)
Runtime: rexruntimerd.dll / rexgpu-xenosrd.dll / TracyClientrd.dll
Do NOT replace with Debug (*d.dll) — assert storms in shader translator.
Mouse look: rexruntimerd.dll ships with raised mnk kBaseScale (pad untouched).
HUD: experimental; hpbar.png + hpbarline.png must sit next to saw2.exe.
Achievements: --saw2_achievements / --no-saw2_achievements (launcher Mods).
Dual res: --video_mode_* (internal) vs --window_* (output).
